component.name: Notes
Anteckningar
component.summary: Write notes on this computer or in your mail account
Skriv anteckningar på datorn eller i ditt e-postkonto

description.p: Notes with headings, lists and simple formatting, kept on this computer or in the Notes folder of an IMAP mail account, in the IMAP notes format other clients use, so the same notes open on your other devices too.
